extension.summary: Rivulet: watch Stremio-protocol catalogs, addons and streams in Kodi
extension.description: Rivulet is a Kodi client for the Stremio addon protocol: browse and search catalogs by type, install community Stremio addons from a manifest URL, resolve streams and play them back through an embedded or remote rivulet-engine streaming server, and optionally sync your addon collection with your Stremio account.
extension.disclaimer: This addon does not host, index or provide any media content. It is a client for third-party Stremio addons that you install yourself.
extension.news: v0.49.0: - New: a "Do not sort" option for the source list keeps the order the add-on gave, so an aggregator such as AIOStreams can put cached sources first. - Fix: the streaming server can no longer be crashed by a malformed request. Comes with rivulet-engine v0.33.3, installed automatically.

extension.description: Add this repository to Kodi to install Rivulet and receive automatic updates.
extension.news: v1.0.2: - Changed: the new Rivulet ripple logo. The artwork shipped with 0.16.0's rebrand, but a repository addon only refetches its icon when its own version changes - this release exists to carry that change to installed copies.
